text:
Maria (CS): Hey team — Asteria Health returned the vendor risk form with two tight asks: SOC2 evidence + strict embeddings retention (they want 30d auto-delete). Also asked about BYOK and non-prod access. Can @Josh (Solutions) confirm options for Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted?

Josh (Solutions): On it. Quick clarifying Qs: do they insist BYOK for hosted? BYOK is only available for Private (VPC/on-prem). Dedicated can do customer-managed keys in some regions. Tagging @Rachael for SOC2/KMS attestation.

Rachael (Security): We can share SOC2 cert and mapping doc. Retention: default platform retention currently 90d for embeddings/logs, but we support per-customer retention when in Dedicated/Private. Hosted can sometimes get contract addendum for shorter retention but not BYOK. Need precise wording from them (do they mean embeddings only or raw inputs + backups?).

Maria (CS): They explicitly said "embeddings and raw text" -> 30 days and auto-delete. Also asked for KMS HSM attestation.

Josh (Solutions): Dedicated + Private path: enforceable retention + KMS integration (Private: BYOK/HSM; Dedicated: CMKs in supported clouds). HSM attestation — we can provide partner attestation and SOC2 reports. For Hosted, offer encryption at rest/in transit + delete-on-request workflows but not BYOK.

Alex (PM): Actionable: add onboarding checklist items: data-retention-policy flag, byok-required flag, legal-contact for DPA redline. CS to confirm if 30d applies to backups/snapshots and non-prod.

Maria (CS): Draft reply I'll send to Asteria (please check):
- We can meet 30-day deletion for embeddings and input logs on Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted may require a DPA addendum and cannot provide BYOK.
- We will provide SOC2 attestation and a dataflow diagram.
- Please confirm whether the 30-day deletion requirement applies to backups/snapshots and non-production environments.
- Please provide your legal contact for DPA review and any redlines.

Rachael (Security): +1. Add: "We can provide KMS provider attestation and HSM details for Private deployments upon request." Also, I'll upload SOC2 artifacts.

repo-bot: Upload: soc2_summary_v4.pdf -> https://redwood.share/soc2_summary_v4.pdf (access: team-redwood/cs-security)

Josh (Solutions): One tweak to the draft: explicitly say we can "enforce deletion for embeddings and input logs; backups may require exception depending on backup provider SLA."

Maria (CS): Good call. Updated draft and sending now. Will post Asteria reply here when we get it. :thumbsup:

Alex (PM): Thanks — tagging onboarding to watch for selection of Dedicated vs Private so infra can prep KMS onboarding. :eyes:

Rachael (Security): If they send legal contact, I'll kick off evidence package transfer and redact any PII in diagrams.

Maria (CS): Sending. Follow-up: ask if they want a short call to review DPA and retention controls or prefer email exchange.
